# DateCube

> DateCube is a 3×3 twistable perpetual desk calendar. One face displays the weekday, month and date. This is the official DateCube website.

## Product facts

- Turn the cube's layers by hand to set the date. It does not advance automatically.
- The working prototype has been manually verified to display any weekday, month and date, including February 29.
- No batteries, charging, screen or app are required to display a date.
- The website photograph shows a handmade prototype with paper labels and a desk stand.
- DateCube is in development. Pricing, a launch date and ordering details have not been announced. Final materials, finish, packaging and included accessories are still being developed.
